title_zh: 读懂 agent 的工作痕迹
description_en: This module is not trying to make you write code immediately. It first trains you to read an AI coding agent handoff: what changed, what actually ran, where it ran, what the output proves, what remains unchecked, and where risk may have entered.
description_zh: 这个模块不是一上来就让你写代码，而是先训练你看懂 AI coding agent（AI 编程代理）的交接记录：改了什么、哪些真的运行过、在哪里运行，输出证明了什么，还有什么没检查，风险可能从哪里进入。
capability_en: You can read a short AI coding-agent handoff and judge what was changed, what ran, where it ran, what failed, what the output proves, what remains unchecked, and whether files or data may already have been affected.
capability_zh: 你能读一小段 AI coding agent（AI 编程代理）的交接记录，并判断：它改了什么、运行了什么、在哪里运行、哪里失败、输出证明了什么、还有什么没检查，以及文件或数据是否可能已经被影响。
refusal_en: An agent update that blends changed files, executed action, output, missing checks, and risk into one vague 'done'.
refusal_zh: 把「改了哪些文件」「运行过什么」「产生了什么输出」「还缺什么检查」「可能有风险」混成一句含糊「做好了」的 agent 汇报。

customization_points.default_profile: Learner uses AI coding agents and has data-work context.
customization_points.rewrite_when: For a learner without AI-agent exposure, replace with spreadsheet automation, no-code tooling, or app-support examples while preserving the text -> command -> output -> risk chain.
For a learner without data background, swap SQL/table anchors for documents, photos, forms, or inbox workflows.
